name: deepastra-swarm
description: Astra plans and supervises; a DeepSeek Flash Agent Team does the work through the DeepSeek Harness.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate planned work to a DeepSeek agent team.
interface.longDescription: DeepAstra Swarm lets Astra hand a planned task to a team of inexpensive DeepSeek Flash agents running in the DeepSeek Harness. The team coordinates through a shared task board, durable mailbox, and findings ledger; Astra receives compressed state, steers on exceptions, and reviews the final report.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan this task, then run it with the swarm and review the result.
